description:
Elevate Commerce Solutions is a digital growth and performance marketing agency accelerating direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce brands and B2B SaaS platforms across Europe and North America. We combine rigorous data analytics, creative testing, and multi-channel media buying to scale customer acquisition, maximize return on ad spend (ROAS), and unlock sustainable revenue growth.

We are hiring an analytical, data-driven Growth Marketing & Paid Media Specialist to lead and scale paid advertising campaigns for our key client portfolios.

You will manage significant advertising budgets across major digital platforms, conduct structured hypothesis-driven creative testing, implement conversion tracking and attribution models, and translate quantitative campaign data into actionable strategic insights.
